I have long thick wavy hair, it's also colored. Having red and burgundy in my hair happy to see the dye didn't strip and I have to say the color is more visible. claims.text: Most reviewers say the product leaves hair soft, silky, and shiny.
Many reviewers praise the coconut scent and easy application/rinse.
Several reviewers note it works well on dry, damaged, or color-treated hair.
A few reviewers complain it is no better than plain coconut oil and left their hair greasy or unchanged.
One reviewer warns the oil can clog drains as it solidifies.
